g.text: SJ1 CONNECTS BUTTON TO ~{RST} (NO, USUALLY USE PA05/I5)
NOTE: DO NOT BACKPOWER BOARD THROUGH SEWTAP+ (OUTPUT ONLY) USE AUX VIN (3.5 TO 6V, AVOID CONTENTION WITH USB)
PROGRAM WITH JTAGICE3 OR ATMEL-ICE USE FIRST SIX PINS OF 10-PIN JTAG CONNECTOR (FOR ATMEL-ICE, PLUG INTO AVR, NOT ARM SIDE) NOTE SQUARE VIA ON PIN 1 (JP3) SET PROGRAMMER TO "SWD" INTERFACE
